Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

eden.uk.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet
eden.uk.description: Antarctica, a land of survivors enduring the most hostile conditions on Earth. Ninety eight per cent of the mainland is covered by ice on which virtually nothing can live. Even the sea freezes over, but the Weddell seal manages to survive here by keeping its breathing holes open by using its teeth to grind away the ice. (Documentary, Nature) - 2019

eden.uk.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet - Asia
eden.uk.description: Asia is the largest and most extreme continent on our planet, stretching from the Arctic Circle in the north to the tropical forests on the equator. The animals here face the hottest deserts, tallest jungles and highest mountains found anywhere on Earth. But the continent has not always looked like this. These extreme worlds were created when India collided with the rest of Asia 30 million years ago, shaping the continent as we know it today. (Documentary, Nature) - 2019

eden.uk.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet - South America
eden.uk.description: From the bone-dry deserts of the Atacama, where penguins weave their way through a minefield of snapping sea lions, to the lush cloud forests of the Andes, where Andean bears scale 30-metre trees in search of elusive fruits, South America is full of the unusual and ingenious. (Documentary, Nature) - 2019

eden.uk.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet - Australia
eden.uk.description: Australia, a land cast adrift at the time of the dinosaurs. Isolated for millions of years, the weird and wonderful animals marooned here are like nowhere else on Earth. In the north of this island continent is the Daintree, one of the world's oldest tropical forests. (Documentary, Nature) - 2019

itv1anglia.uk.title: Deal or No Deal
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E55 Sue Stephen Mulhern hosts as Sue opens the iconic red boxes - will she be tempted to take an offer from the Banker, or will she hold out in the hope that she has 100,000 pounds inside her box? There's only one question.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E8 South Wales James is in South Wales and accompanied by Michelin-starred chef Stephen Terry as they discover award-winning Welsh wine and organic Welsh chocolate.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itv1anglia.uk.description: S6 E25 Joining Alan to provide the chat this time are Selina Scott, Pixie Lott and Tom Parker-Bowles, and we also meet some rare-breed Guernsey goats with a royal title.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
itv1anglia.uk.description: S3 E14 Fearne Cotton Prue is joined by TV and radio presenter Fearne Cotton, who makes her favourite carrot cake with blueberry icing mousse and explains how painting and baking are her escape from the stresses of everyday life. Prue and her husband John turn back the clock to the 1970s and make a prawn cocktail sharing platter, while he has the tricky task of fanning an avocado and carving radish rosettes.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News
itv1anglia.uk.description: E75 03/10/2026 A round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itv1anglia.uk.description: S9 E29 James welcomes best-selling Irish novelist Cecelia Ahern to the house, while there are recipes from chefs Knox Majozi, Nathan Outlaw and Kenny Atkinson.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Gary Barlow's Food and Wine Tour: New Zealand
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E6 Hawkes Bay Gary and Jason Manford arrive in Hawke's Bay for the final leg of the journey, with the pair taking a classic car tour through Napier's famous art deco streets, before they feed rescued korora penguins at the National Aquarium. They join an autumn equinox gathering at Atea a Rangi, before they visit Craggy Range wineries to raise a glass at the end of their epic road trip.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
itv1anglia.uk.description: E73 03/10/2026 - 1 Round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV Racing: Live from Ascot : 03/10/2026
itv1anglia.uk.description: Ed Chamberlin presents coverage of a meeting headlined by the Cumberland Lodge Stakes from Ascot, plus the Sun Chariot Stakes take centre-stage at Newmarket, and two races can be seen from Redcar. With analysis from Jason Weaver and Adele Mulrennan, reports by Rishi Persad and Natalie Green, and commentary from Richard Hoiles.

itv1anglia.uk.title: UEFA Nations League Live : Croatia v England
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E3 Croatia v England (Kick-off 5.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the third Group A3 match for both teams, held at Stadion HNK Rijeka. Croatia famously knocked England out of the 2018 FIFA World Cup at the semi-final stage, but the Three Lions have won three and drawn one of the four meetings between the sides since then. The most recent of those contests came in the group stage of this summer's World Cup, when England won an entertaining game 4-2 thanks to a brace by Harry Kane and further strikes from Jude Bellingham and Marcus Rashford. With analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and interviews by Gabriel Clarke.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News and Weather

itv1anglia.uk.title: Win Win
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E2 Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins host the interactive quiz show in which viewers get the chance to win the same prizes as the contestants playing in the studio. Plus, a viewer from last week's show joins Mel and Sue in the studio where contestants face a nail-biting decision: do they take a prize and leave the game, or do they join Millionaire's Row.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Voice UK
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2026 E6 Emma Willis hosts the spinning-chair singing contest, with coaches Tom Jones, Will.i.am, Kelly Rowland, Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones assessing more acts. With only eight places available on each team, the mentors must choose carefully as they search for the UK's most exciting singing talent, with the Rewind button giving them the chance to bring back an artist they regret letting go.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E5 Robbie Savage and his son Charlie, Helen Flanagan and her mum Julia, and Tayce and her dad Qariem Radix compete in the comedy game show. The parents choose which questions their children will answer and gamble on how many they can get right. If the contestants meet expectations they will get the money, but fall short and the cash is split between the other teams.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E3 Jeremy Clarkson hosts the quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for the £1 million prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, but will they be able to do so.

stvnorth.uk.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
stvnorth.uk.description: S3 E14 Fearne Cotton Prue is joined by TV and radio presenter Fearne Cotton, who makes her favourite carrot cake with blueberry icing mousse and explains how painting and baking are her escape from the stresses of everyday life. Prue and her husband John turn back the clock to the 1970s and make a prawn cocktail sharing platter, while he has the tricky task of fanning an avocado and carving radish rosettes.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News
stvnorth.uk.description: E75 03/10/2026 A round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
stvnorth.uk.description: S9 E29 James welcomes best-selling Irish novelist Cecelia Ahern to the house, while there are recipes from chefs Knox Majozi, Nathan Outlaw and Kenny Atkinson.

stvnorth.uk.title: Gary Barlow's Food and Wine Tour: New Zealand
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E6 Hawkes Bay Gary and Jason Manford arrive in Hawke's Bay for the final leg of the journey, with the pair taking a classic car tour through Napier's famous art deco streets, before they feed rescued korora penguins at the National Aquarium. They join an autumn equinox gathering at Atea a Rangi, before they visit Craggy Range wineries to raise a glass at the end of their epic road trip.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: E73 03/10/2026 - 1 Round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: STV Racing: Live from Ascot : 03/10/2026
stvnorth.uk.description: Ed Chamberlin presents coverage of a meeting headlined by the Cumberland Lodge Stakes from Ascot, plus the Sun Chariot takes centre-stage at Newmarket, and two races can be seen from Redcar. With analysis from Jason Weaver and Adele Mulrennan, reports by Rishi Persad and Natalie Green, and commentary from Richard Hoiles.

stvnorth.uk.title: UEFA Nations League Live : Croatia v England
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E3 Croatia v England (Kick-off 5.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the third Group A3 match for both teams, held at Stadion HNK Rijeka. Croatia famously knocked England out of the 2018 FIFA World Cup at the semi-final stage, but the Three Lions have won three and drawn one of the four meetings between the sides since then. The most recent of those contests came in the group stage of this summer's World Cup, when England won an entertaining game 4-2 thanks to a brace by Harry Kane and further strikes from Jude Bellingham and Marcus Rashford. With analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and interviews by Gabriel Clarke.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: S11 E76 03/10/2026 - 2 Round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: Win Win
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E2 Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins host the interactive quiz show in which viewers get the chance to win the same prizes as the contestants playing in the studio. Plus, a viewer from last week's show joins Mel and Sue in the studio where contestants face a nail-biting decision: do they take a prize and leave the game, or do they join Millionaire's Row.

stvnorth.uk.title: The Voice UK
stvnorth.uk.description: S2026 E6 Emma Willis hosts the spinning-chair singing contest, with coaches Tom Jones, Will.i.am, Kelly Rowland, Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones assessing more acts. With only eight places available on each team, the mentors must choose carefully as they search for the UK's most exciting singing talent, with the Rewind button giving them the chance to bring back an artist they regret letting go.

stvnorth.uk.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E5 Robbie Savage and his son Charlie, Helen Flanagan and her mum Julia, and Tayce and her dad Qariem Radix compete in the comedy game show. The parents choose which questions their children will answer and gamble on how many they can get right. If the contestants meet expectations they will get the money, but fall short and the cash is split between the other teams.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: E78 03/10/2026 - 3 Round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: English Football League Highlights : 03/10/2026
stvnorth.uk.description: S5 E10 Action from the latest matches, including Wigan Athletic v Mansfield Town at Brick Community Stadium and Leyton Orient v Plymouth Argyle at BetWright Stadium in League One, and Crewe Alexandra v Bristol Rovers at Mornflake Stadium and Walsall v Crawley Town at Pallet-Track Bescot Stadium in League Two.

stvnorth.uk.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E3 Jeremy Clarkson hosts the quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for the £1 million prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, but will they be able to do so.

yesterday.uk.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It ║ 2/20
yesterday.uk.description: Max McMurdo restores a pair of designer chairs, while Henry Cole breathes new life into a decrepit garden table, transforming it into a colourful and valuable new one.

yesterday.uk.title: Secrets of the London Underground ║ 3/9
yesterday.uk.description: Tim Dunn and Siddy Holloway snoop around TFL's gargantuan maintenance facility - Acton Works.

yesterday.uk.title: Teleshopping
yesterday.uk.description: Shopping from Home.

yesterday.uk.title: Secrets of the London Underground ║ 3/10
yesterday.uk.description: Tim Dunn and Siddy Holloway explore hidden parts of Archway. Once called Highgate to encourage more people to travel there before an actual Highgate station existed.

yesterday.uk.title: Great Canal Journeys ║ 6/1
yesterday.uk.description: Tim and Pru explore one of the world's great waterways - the River Nile - while travelling from Luxor to Aswan, visiting a Nubian village, and dancing by moonlight.

yesterday.uk.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching for Italy ║ 1/1
yesterday.uk.description: Stanley explores Tuscany, with Renaissance scholar Elisabetta Di Giugno taking him on a tour of Florence's wine bars, before he attends a threshing festival.

yesterday.uk.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching for Italy ║ 1/2
yesterday.uk.description: Stanley heads to Sicily, where he meets artisanal winemaker Arianna Occhipinti and dines with Princess Stefania di Raffadali in Palermo.

yesterday.uk.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching for Italy ║ 1/3
yesterday.uk.description: Stanley visits Milan, the capital of Lombardy, where he goes for aperitivo with a social media star and tries some of the Missoni family's favourite dishes.

yesterday.uk.title: Train Rescue Down Under ║ 1/2
yesterday.uk.description: The construction of a 130-tonne locomotive in Newcastle is nearing the finish line, and an overnight crew must get a Brisbane train on track before the morning commute.

yesterday.uk.title: Flipping Bangers ║ 2/10
yesterday.uk.description: Gus and Will seek a Scandinavian car and settle on a Saab. They'd prefer a classic 99, but can only find an older 99 that was bought for a rally but can't go the distance.

yesterday.uk.title: Flipping Bangers ║ 2/11
yesterday.uk.description: Gus and Will set out to buy a Honda-based Rover 800 coupe. At only 650 pounds it seems too good to be true - and when they turn up, they aren't sure whether to proceed.

yesterday.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries ║ 5/8
yesterday.uk.description: Robbie Cumming takes a tumble at Buckby Locks in Northamptonshire and has a problem with his power supply and battery bank.

yesterday.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries ║ 5/9
yesterday.uk.description: A window gets smashed onboard the Naughty Lass and Robbie Cumming receives a soaking inside the very wet Blisworth Tunnel on the Grand Union Canal.

yesterday.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
yesterday.uk.description: Barton Swing Aqueduct to Liverpool: Robbie Cumming concludes his journey by travelling from Barton Swing Aqueduct to Liverpool Docks - but experiences engine problems on the way. [S]

yesterday.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
yesterday.uk.description: Stratford-upon-Avon to Birmingham: Robbie crosses an epic aqueduct near Stratford-upon-Avon and gets stuck in a lock in central Birmingham. [S]

yesterday.uk.title: Blue Planet ║ 2/1
yesterday.uk.description: Marine life around the world, from dolphins and tusk fish in a tropical coral reef to walruses struggling to cope with the impact of climate change on the polar north.

yesterday.uk.title: Blue Planet ║ 2/2
yesterday.uk.description: Creatures that live in volcanic hot spots on the ocean bed, areas that reach temperatures hot enough to melt lead and which may hold the secrets behind all life on Earth.

yesterday.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics ║ 8/1
yesterday.uk.description: It's a battle of little and large as the team get creative with a 1996 Fiat 126 and then run their own consumer test on a 2004 Bentley Continental GT.

yesterday.uk.title: Bangers & Cash ║ 14/11
yesterday.uk.description: Derek collects an iconic 1930s Jaguar and Dave eyes a replica artillery piece from the American Civil War.

yesterday.uk.title: Classic Car Kings ║ 1/5
yesterday.uk.description: Irv is an expert in VW Sambas, so when a collector with a bunch of rusted panels and the dream of a showroom-quality vehicle needs help, there's only one man for the job.

yesterday.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics ║ 8/2
yesterday.uk.description: The team seek out a sturdy, reliable 4x4 to tackle the rugged Yorkshire landscape in, but get side-tracked into a slightly rusty Subaru Impreza Turbo 2000.

yesterday.uk.title: Bangers & Cash ║ 10/12
yesterday.uk.description: Dave travels to leafy Leicestershire where Steve Perry has a 1980 Ford Granada Ghia and a 1981 Ford Cortina.

yesterday.uk.title: Bangers & Cash ║ 10/13
yesterday.uk.description: Derek heads to County Durham, where Neil Walker is selling his late dad's car collection, including a Japanese take on a classic British Jag: the Mitsuoka Viewt.

yesterday.uk.title: Bangers & Cash ║ 11/5
yesterday.uk.description: Jack's drawn the short straw again as he attempts to shift a couple of 1930's Austin Sevens that have been stuck in the same spot for half a century.

amc.us.title: Insidious
amc.us.description: A family looks to prevent evil spirits from trapping their comatose child in a realm called The Further. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2010

amc.us.title: Insidious: Chapter 2
amc.us.description: Soon after their showdown with evil spirits that possessed their son, the Lamberts, Renai and Josh, are ready for their lives to return to normal. However, something still is seriously off, especially with Josh, who -- unbeknown to Renai -- is possessed too. In order to free Josh's soul and finally defeat the malevolent forces around them, Lorraine Lambert and her ghost-hunting friends investigate the past to save her family's future. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2013

amc.us.title: Insidious: Chapter 3
amc.us.description: When teenager Quinn Brenner (Stefanie Scott) senses that her late mother is trying to contact her, she seeks help from gifted psychic Elise Rainier (Lin Shaye). However, Elise's tragic past makes her reluctant to use her abilities. After Quinn is attacked by a malevolent entity, her father (Dermot Mulroney) pleads with Elise for help. With support from two parapsychologists, Elise ventures deep into The Further -- where she finds a powerful demon with an insatiable craving for human souls. (Horror, Thriller) - 2015

amc.us.title: The Shining
amc.us.description: Jack Torrance (Jack Nicholson) becomes winter caretaker at the isolated Overlook Hotel in Colorado, hoping to cure his writer's block. He settles in along with his wife, Wendy (Shelley Duvall), and his son, Danny (Danny Lloyd), who is plagued by psychic premonitions. As Jack's writing goes nowhere and Danny's visions become more disturbing, Jack discovers the hotel's dark secrets and begins to unravel into a homicidal maniac hell-bent on terrorizing his family. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

amc.us.title: Graveyard Shift
amc.us.description: After an abandoned textile mill reopens, several employees die; the deaths occur between 11 p.m. and 7 a.m. during the graveyard shift. A mill foreman assigns a group to clean the basement; the workers find a network of tunnels leading to a cemetery and an unknown creature. (Holiday, Horror) - 1990

amc.us.title: Pet Sematary
amc.us.description: Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient. (Horror, Thriller) - 1989

amc.us.title: Silver Bullet
amc.us.description: When a series of unexplained murders occurs in the normally quiet town of Tarker's Mill, the residents decide to hunt down the killer. However, many of these vigilantes end up dead, and those who don't are any closer to finding an assailant. But, when a young wheelchair-using boy named Marty encounters a werewolf one night, the pieces begin to come together. Along with his sister and Uncle Red, Marty begins a mission to capture the werewolf once and for all. (Horror) - 1985

amc.us.title: Stephen King's It
amc.us.description: Seven friends engage in a struggle with the demon they first encountered 30-years earlier in their Maine hometown. From the Stephen King book. (Horror, Drama, Mystery, Thriller, Miniseries) - 1990-11-18

amc.us.title: Christine
amc.us.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

amc.us.title: It
amc.us.description: Seven young outcasts in Derry, Maine, are about to face their worst nightmare -- an ancient, shape-shifting evil that emerges from the sewer every 27 years to prey on the town's children. Banding together over the course of one horrifying summer, the friends must overcome their own personal fears to battle the murderous, bloodthirsty clown known as Pennywise. (Horror, Thriller) - 2017

Nicky could think of 666 things he'd rather be doing than corrupting souls or spewing evil, but when his father's command over Hades is threatened by his bullying older brothers, it's up to unbalanced Nicky to restore the balance between Good and Evil on earth. vh1.us.title: Coming to America

To escape an arranged marriage, Akeem flees to America accompanied by his persnickety sidekick, Semmi (Arsenio Hall), to find his queen. Disguised as a foreign student working in fast food, he romances Lisa (Shari Headley), but struggles with revealing his true identity to her and his marital intentions to his king father (James Earl Jones). (Comedy, Romance, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy) - 1988

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: When a little girl got sick and died, investigators were stumped. Was it an accident, an unexplained illness, or murder?

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: When a car was found in a drainage ditch with two bodies inside, a fingertip torn from a latex glove would point investigators to both the crime scene and the killer.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: A World War II veteran was found dead in his home, and the investigation ground to a halt when the prime suspect had a solid alibi. But a lucky break led to a shady character who wore distinctive boots and had a sweet tooth.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: A woman who was known to have suffered from depression apparently took her own life. But her sister told police that, a year before her death, she said if anything were to happen to her, there was a note in the china cabinet.¾

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: When an off-duty policeman was shot dead, his fellow officers were determined to solve the crime. They needed clues to find the killer, and they discovered them in tiny fibers and an asthma inhaler.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: One warm summer afternoon, the town of Verona, Wisconsin faced its first triple homicide. To solve the case, investigators had to delve into the world of high rollers and offshore betting.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: The body of a young girl was discovered on isolated farmland near Delano, California. She had no ID, but police found mailbox keys in the pocket of her jeans. With no other clues, they checked the mailboxes of every apartment building in Delano.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: The driver said he couldn't have hit and killed a pedestrian on a Harrisburg street. The Jeep Grand Cherokee he was leasing around that time had been sold months ago to a buyer in another state.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: The medical examiner ruled the death an accident, but the detectives investigating the case thought the evidence at the scene indicated otherwise.¾

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: The medical examiner ruled the death an accident, but the detectives investigating the case thought the evidence at the scene indicated otherwise.¾

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: A woman was found dead on the bedroom floor of her apartment. The crime scene yielded little of value, and investigators wondered if they would find enough evidence to make a case, much less catch a killer.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: A young man was killed in a mysterious car crash, but the evidence at the scene led investigators to believe it was not an accident. Forensic science revealed what really happened, and the truth devastated three families.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: When a woman went missing, friends and family were determined to find her. Their worst fears were confirmed weeks later when her body was discovered.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: In 1993, 82-year-old Kathryn Bishop was found dead in her Pennsylvania home. Tiny clues on the victim's body would tell police what happened that night.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: A wealthy man and his wife were attacked by three masked men outside their luxurious Louisiana home. He was shot dead and she was forced to open their hidden safe. To solve the crime, police would have to find out who knew about the concealed safe.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: The bomb was constructed to cause as much damage as possible... and it did, killing the victim with deadly force and flame. A painstaking search yielded tiny clues, which identified the killer as surely as if he'd signed them.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: A twelve-year-old girl claimed she had been abducted and sexually assaulted. She recounted what happened in such a flat, unemotional voice that police found it difficult to believe her. Fibers on her clothing would prove she was telling the truth.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: The wife of a respected police officer was murdered in her own home. The crime went unsolved for more than a decade, and then a newly formed Cold Case Unit took a fresh look at the evidence.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: The victim had ingested a massive amount of cyanide. An unlikely clue _ a flaw on a mailing envelope _ exposed a murderer who was willing to kill innocent people.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: They thought the fire would cover their crime. But one tiny clue, no bigger than a thumbtack, remained. It held all the information investigators needed to put a trio of cold-blooded killers behind bars.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: In 1994, 19-year-old Shannon Melendi disappeared while at Emory University. For ten years, her disappearance remained a mystery, until new scientific testing cast a different light on Colvin 'Butch' Hinton.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: In 1987, the death of Crystal Purcell was considered an accident. Then in 2001, Barbara Purcell called police to suggest that her estranged husband Willard had killed Crystal, who was her husband at the time of her death.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: In 1994, Paul Gruber's daughter suspected something was wrong when she received birthday cards addressed from Gruber, on which the handwriting wasn't Gruber's.¾

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: How did the stalker obtain the security system code for his victim's home? How did he steal her personal photographs? Police needed answers, and they found them in the most unlikely of places.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: After inspecting storm damage to a home in Tampa, the insurance assessor simply disappeared. Thirty hours later, her body was found in a nearby river. But the killer had been careless.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: When a hit-and-run accident claimed the life of a high school athlete, everyone in town mourned his passing. Finding the killer was a long shot at best.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: A murder trail turned cold, until police got a call from a woman whose husband, Gerald Powers, had a criminal past and a fondness for Chevy Berettas.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: In 1991, Grand Junction, Colorado is on edge after a series of deadly bombings which has killed 2 and injured one more. Police race to find the culprit before he strikes again.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed not only a clue no one had seen before but also the identity of the killer.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: A lifelong resident of the tiny town of Lefroy, Tasmania was murdered outside his own home. Robbery appeared to be the motive, but with no suspects, the investigation came to a halt.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: When a wealthy socialite died after falling down the stairs, witnesses said one thing and evidence indicated another. To find out what really happened, investigators turned to forensic science, a physicist and an expert in accident reconstruction.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: In 1996, when Derrick Duehren returned to his Oregon home, it had burned to the ground and his wife Roxanne's charred remains were found in the rubble. Investigators set out to determine if it was an unfortunate accident or arson and murder.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: A millionaire and his family were executed in their own home. For three years, the murders went unsolved and then a 30-year-old box of ammunition and some fluorescent fibers revealed the ultimate betrayal.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: It was one of the most brazen crimes of the 20th century.¾Adolph Coors III, chairman of the Coors Brewing Company, was kidnapped and held for ransom prompting one of the most intense manhunts in United States history.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: The development of technology could help solve a murder case that is twelve years old.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: When a young girl was found dead, police quickly arrested the most likely suspect. But cutting-edge technology from NASA enabled a forensic odonatologist to prove the wrong man was behind bars.¾

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: It's usually easy to determine how a criminal entered the crime scene. But in this case, it was far from clear. It looked like the killer vanished into thin air...and perhaps he had.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: Security cameras in a casino tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: It was one of the most unusual cases in forensic history. Investigators had to find a way to solve a murder case with evidence which consisted of a squashed tomato found at the crime scene, and tiny, pinpoint reflections of light in a photograph.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: When a dedicated, well-respected teacher disappeared, police had to determine if she'd gone on vacation without telling anyone, or if she was the victim of foul play.¾

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: Seattle police had no suspects in the violent murder of post-grunge singer, Mia Zapata. More than a decade passed before the evidence collected by a prescient medical examiner could be used by forensic scientists to identify the killer.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: A Michigan State University grad student disappeared and was presumed dead. With the help of a professor of geological sciences, police hoped to get the 'dirt' on her killer.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: How unlucky could one man be? His wife took her own life, and his college sweetheart killed herself in much the same fashion fourteen years earlier. Investigators had to determine if this was just a bizarre coincidence, or murder.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: In 1996, 54-year-old Gayle Isleib was ambushed in her Manchester, Connecticut driveway and shot to death. Now police must determine if love had turned into obsession... and a motive for murder.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home, and the only evidence¾the kidnapper¾left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

671083.title: Forensic Files
671083.description: A brutal murder, lots of suspects, and conflicting evidence but the forensics were clear on one thing: The killer knew his victim. And that alone gave investigators a head start.

673498.title: The Big Gundown
673498.description: Lawman John Corbett (Lee Van Cleef) searches the U.S.-Mexico border for a Mexican peasant (Tomas Milian) accused of raping and killing a 12-year-old girl.

673498.title: Headin' East
673498.description: A cowboy discards his chaps and saddle for a suit and tie when he travels to the big city to investigate a produce racket that has been ruining his father's lettuce shipments.

673498.title: The Law vs. Billy the Kid
673498.description: The notorious gunslinger’s new courtship with a rancher's lovely daughter is cut prematurely short when the law unexpectedly catches up with him.

673498.title: Face of a Fugitive
673498.description: While being escorted to jail, bank robber Jim Larson (Fred MacMurray) manages to get the upper hand on his captor and escape. Jim is surprised to see his brother appear on the scene, ready to aid his sibling. As they make their getaway, his brother and the pursuing lawman shoot each other, leaving the stunned Jim alone and on the run. Assuming a different identity, Jim travels to a mining town and befriends the local sheriff (Lin McCarthy), hoping to start over and find redemption.

673498.title: The Longest Drive
673498.description: After a decade apart, a pair of brothers reunites to find their long-lost sister, who was kidnapped as a child and is now living with a native tribe.

673498.title: Gun Fury
673498.description: California-bound rancher Ben Warren (Rock Hudson) is shot and left for dead when a demented ex-Confederate, Frank Slayton (Phil Carey), kidnaps his Southern bride-to-be (Donna Reed). Revived, Ben sets out to rescue her. Along the way, he picks up Jess Burgess (Leo Gordon), a slighted former member of Slayton's gang, and American Indian local Johash (Pat Hogan), who has his own beef with the outlaws. Together they embark on a perilous chase toward the Mexican border to stop Slayton.

673498.title: Headin' East
673498.description: A cowboy discards his chaps and saddle for a suit and tie when he travels to the big city to investigate a produce racket that has been ruining his father's lettuce shipments.

673498.title: Cripple Creek
673498.description: A federal agent (George Montgomery) and two colleagues infiltrate a gang of gold-rush gold smugglers.

673498.title: Masterson of Kansas
673498.description: In the 1870s, Marshal Wyatt Earp (Bruce Cowling) calls upon Dodge City, Kan., Sheriff Bat Masterson (George Montgomery) to track down rancher Merrick (John Maxwell), who is accused of murder. But, thanks to some proof held by local Native American Chief Yellow Hawk (Jay Silverheels), Masterson realizes Merrick might be the victim of a frame-up. So, with the help of Earp and gunfighter Doc Holliday (James Griffith), Masterson sets out to find those who are really behind the killing.

673498.title: Battle of Rogue River
673498.description: A cavalry major (George Montgomery) makes peace with Indians despite an agitator (Richard Denning) working for carpetbaggers.

673498.title: The Last Frontier
673498.description: Jed Cooper (Victor Mature), a trapper, enlists as an army fort scout, and shortly after meets and falls for Corinna Marston (Anne Bancroft), the wife of a nearby fort's commander. Jed comes across her husband, Col. Marston (Robert Preston), after he's suffered an attack at the hands of Native Americans. Col. Marston forces the captain of Jed's fort, Glenn Riordan (Guy Madison), to send out Jed and the troops to fight his attackers, despite their lack of battle experience.

673498.title: Go West, Young Girl!
673498.description: New England writer Netty (Karen Valentine) and cavalry widow Gilda (Sandra Will) team up to find Billy the Kid.

673498.title: The Pathfinder
673498.description: Based on the novel of the same name, a scout is sent by the British to infiltrate a French stronghold near the Great Lakes in the 1750s.

673498.title: Unknown Valley
673498.description: Joe goes looking for his missing father in the desert, then strange villagers take him captive; he finds his father and plans to escape, taking with him a woman that he has fallen for.

673498.title: Go West, Young Girl!
673498.description: New England writer Netty (Karen Valentine) and cavalry widow Gilda (Sandra Will) team up to find Billy the Kid.

673498.title: Reprisal!
673498.description: Frank Madden (Guy Madison), who is part Native American but passes as white, purchases a ranch in the small town of Kendall, Okla. When Frank moves in, he finds that the bigoted townspeople have recently let three brothers, who are also his neighbors, get away with the lynching murder of innocent Native Americans. As tensions between the townspeople and local Native Americans rise, Hank becomes torn between fighting against injustice and keeping his true identity a secret.

673500.title: The Caine Mutiny
673500.description: During World War II, a dilapidated vessel, the Caine, gets a new ensign, Willis Keith (Robert Francis), and a new captain, Commander Queeg (Humphrey Bogart). The crew sees Queeg's unconventional behavior as irrational, and communications officer Thomas Keefer (Fred MacMurray) spreads suspicion about his suitability as captain. When a dire situation during a storm forces the executive officer (Van Johnson) to relieve Queeg of his duties, he and Ensign Keith are tried for mutiny.

673500.title: His Girl Friday
673500.description: A crafty editor for the Morning Post news uses every trick in the book to keep his fast-talking, ace reporter ex-wife from remarrying her new beau

673500.title: Don't Knock the Twist
673500.description: Dancers prepare for a TV special on the twist in this musical featuring performances of chart-topping hits from the heyday of rock 'n' roll.

673500.title: The Heroes of Telemark
673500.description: In German-occupied Norway in 1942, a resistance group attempts to sabotage the Nazi's production of essential atomic bomb components.

673500.title: The Lone Wolf and His Lady
673500.description: When a gem disappears from an exhibition, jewel-thief-turned-reporter Lone Wolf (Ron Randell) is accused.

673500.title: Paula
673500.description: After her second miscarriage, Paula Rogers (Loretta Young) learns she is sterile. On the way to a reception for her professor husband, John (Kent Smith), a distraught Paula accidentally hits an orphan (Tommy Rettig) with her car. Thinking Paula is drunk, farmer Raymond Bascom (Will Wright) takes the boy to the hospital. Unwilling to confess her role in the hit-and-run for fear of derailing John's career, Paula volunteers at the hospital and helps Davey recover without admitting her guilt.

673500.title: Queen Bee
673500.description: A naive, working-class Chicagoan enters a world of bitter jealousy and manipulative power plays when invited to Atlanta by her socialite elder cousin.

673500.title: Harriet Craig
673500.description: A cold, perfectionist wife will stop at nothing to have her house and life run as she wishes, even if it means controlling her husband's every move.

673500.title: It Happened to Jane
673500.description: When a shipment of expired shellfish arrives to her New England lobstery, Jane Osgood decides to take a capitalist railroad tycoon to court.

673500.title: Twentieth Century

692057.title: Alien Corridors by Daniel Oron
692057.description: Washington state holds the nation's highest rates of UFO sightings per capita. With so many strange sightings, our investigators turn their cameras to the sky to see whether they too can capture the flight path of something unknown.

692057.title: Alien Corridors by Daniel Oron
692057.description: A strange formation is seen in the sky over the suburbs of Tinley Park. The lights return for a second time almost to the date the following year. These are some of the most corroborated sightings in the history of the United States.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: The programme comes from all four of the Royal Horticultural Society gardens, where the team are out on the road exploring how each location's differing climate affects the plants they grow. Carol Klein broadcasts from Wisley in Surrey. In the garden at Harlow Carr in Yorkshire, Joe Swift gets plenty of propagating tips. Rachel de Thame explores the gardens at Hyde Hall in Essex, and Monty Don visits Rosemoor in Devon.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don has advice on how to successfully store an apple crop so it will last through winter and explains why he thinks it high time wall flowers came back into fashion. With tomatoes now over, Monty clears his greenhouse and plans for next year by planting garlic in the vegetable garden. Meanwhile, Carol is home at Glebe Cottage, dividing her perennials to continue the cost-effective stocking of her new beds.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow, Monty is planning for next summer by sowing a batch of sweet peas. Meanwhile, Carol Klein is amongst the leaves, bark and berries at Thorp Perrow Arboretum in Yorkshire admiring the onset of the autumn display. Plus, there's a visit to Ryton Gardens in Warwickshire to find out about their collection of heritage vegetables and how to collect their seeds.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With autumn well under way, some plants in the garden need to be brought in under cover. Monty Don makes a start by insulating his greenhouse to provide a winter home for all sorts of tender plants and gives his tips and techniques for ensuring their survival until next year. Carol Klein visits the garden of a tropical plant enthusiast to find out how he protects some of his exotic specimens.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don gets going with some autumn garden maintenance whilst looking back over the year and reviewing his borders - which plants have done well and others that haven't. As he clears annuals that are past their best he plans a colourful display for late spring by planting up the garden with tulips. Carol Klein is at Glebe Cottage continuing work on her new raised beds and taming an overgrown and unruly rambling rose.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: In this Christmas edition, the team celebrate the festive season from a gardener's point of view. At Longmeadow, Monty and Rachel have a good clear up. Monty rejuvenates his rhubarb patch, introducing a local Herefordshire heritage variety apple tree to his orchard. Meanwhile, Carol discovers some of Britain's best winter walks and Rachel gets some tips on how to make beautiful Christmas decorations for the garden.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As well as looking at the changes to his garden that have taken place over winter, Monty Don reveals how to plant bare-rooted raspberries in his renovated fruit garden and gets his secateurs out to rejuvenate an overgrown winter flowering honeysuckle. Plus, Monty recommends jobs for the weekend to ensure that all our seeds, seedlings and plants get off to the best possible start.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Jacqui, 26 and Yung, 27, moved into their Trowbridge home a year ago. While they have managed to decorate the house, with their busy jobs they have never had time to fix up the tired garden. It's dull and featureless, with lots of random brickwork. As they admit that they have no idea about gardening, they've called in Charlie and the Rich brothers and given them a budget of £3,500 to create a contemporary space with bright-coloured flowers, a relaxation area and lots of room for their dog.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Jo and Olu have a new baby, Maya, but the garden of their Reading home is a health and safety nightmare, with broken slates, rotten decking, an old pond and an overgrown meadow. They have been trying to get landscapers to redo their garden for months, but no-one has been prepared to tackle it. It's a big job, but if anyone can do it, it's Charlie Dimmock and the Rich brothers.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Esme and Richard live in Rugby; she's a vet, so they share their first marital home with seven pets. The garden is currently a new build blank canvas, with just turf and a small shed, but the couple want to turn it into a pet-friendly paradise.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Anu and Ash live in Coventry with their cat Quinn. Their garden is currently a new-build blank canvas, divided into two cramped tiers, but the couple want to turn it into a pet-friendly delight, inspired by the gardens and countryside they fell in love with on holidays in Tuscany. They want lots of interesting things for Quinn and a large patio where they can entertain their friends and family. Arit Anderson and Charlie Dimmock have a £3,500 budget to make the couple's dreams come true.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Seventy-year-old Maureen has recently moved to a new house in Langford in Bedfordshire, but she's far from in love with her garden. She has left behind a fantastic garden in Spain that she shared with her late husband Graham. Maureen wants the new garden to be a reminder of her life with Graham, with a sense of their old mountain views mixed with a Cordoba-style courtyard, inspired by their travels. Can Charlie and the Rich brothers transport this blank canvas to Spain for just £3,000?

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Ian and Ruth run a Welsh sheep farm in Rhayader, Powys. They have almost 150 acres of land, but they don't have a garden, and Ruth has always dreamt of her own 'Beatrix Potter' style one: a country cottage garden mix of flowers and vegetables, along with family farming heirlooms. What Ruth doesn't want is any patios, paving or decking. Charlie Dimmock and the Rich brothers have just £2,500 and whatever they find on the farm to create a beautiful garden in the middle of a large, empty field.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow this week, Monty reaps a harvest from the vegetable garden, plants up a seasonal pot and gives a masterclass on how to make the perfect compost. Adam Frost travels to York to meet a couple who took on 20 acres of land and filled it with flowers.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: It's all about the maintenance this week at Longmeadow, as Monty cuts back and divides spring flowering plants. Joe Swift and Adam Frost meet up in Leicestershire to see how they can help a couple of novice gardeners turn a neglected area of their garden into a useable and useful space. Nick Bailey goes to Ham House in Richmond to see how they are coping with the ravages of box tree caterpillar and Arit Anderson visits a garden in Suffolk to find out about the concept of rewilding.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don gets going with some autumn garden maintenance whilst looking back over the year and reviewing his borders - which plants have done well and others that haven't. As he clears annuals that are past their best he plans a colourful display for late spring by planting up the garden with tulips. Carol Klein is at Glebe Cottage continuing work on her new raised beds and taming an overgrown and unruly rambling rose.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don tackles autumn lawn maintenance tasks, Carol Klein is looking at burnets, and we meet a man who's dedicated himself to a North American prairie favourite, the echinacea.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With the official start of spring and Mothering Sunday only days away, Monty Don and the team look at the practical ways to achieve a better looking garden at this busy time of year. Monty is selecting and planting climbing roses at his garden in Herefordshire and gives plenty of advice on how to get them to thrive.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As the clocks move forward, the longer days of spring are welcomed by every gardener. It's a busy time in the garden and the longer daylight hours present a great opportunity to get on with larger gardening projects. Weather permitting, Joe will join Monty in his garden to get to grips with lining his newly created pond giving plenty of advice for anyone wanting to use water in the garden.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With the garden growing apace, Monty shows us how we can take advantage of the new growth of all sorts of perennials, and begins by taking cuttings from emerging Delphiniums in his border and also from a pot grown plant. He also demonstrates the best way of planting Clematis against a wall to ensure a profusion of summer flowers.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: It's Easter and the biggest gardening weekend of the year. The team give plenty of advice and inspiration - from large projects to tackling weeds. At Longmeadow, Monty is getting started on the vegetable plot, where he recommends a palette of potatoes for delicious summer crops. He also returns to his newly created pond, where he is showing how to conceal the liner with an attractive edge.

702891.title: Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
702891.description: These creatures love the beach just as much as Jungle Jack!

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: He was a recluse who spread terror through the mail for 18 years. Two men died and more than a dozen were injured, but Ted Kaczynski wasn't known as the Unabomber until his brother tipped off the FBI. Kaczynski's “Unabomber Manifesto,” published in major newspapers, set off a flurry of activity for the FBI: writing analysis and comparisons, DNA gleaned from a single postage stamp and finally, Kaczynski's arrest at his tiny cabin.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared from a Christmas party in December 1989, the only probable suspect was 24-year-old Caleb Hughes. Hughes reportedly left the party around the time Melissa vanished, but no one saw him with the girl. Fifty blue acrylic fibers collected during a search of Hughes' car, however, became the major piece of evidence in the case. FBI fiber analysis determined that those fibers were identical to the ones that made up the sweater Melissa was wearing.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 26, 1993, an explosion rocked the World Trade Center parking garage. Six people died and more than a thousand were injured in the bomb blast that tore a 5-story crater in the building. During the investigation, the twisted fender of a rental van was extracted from the rubble. The FBI was able to determine from where the van was rented and by whom. Undercover agents then made their arrests within six days of the bombing.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1984, south Miami became the home for a sadistic serial killer. Posing as a fashion photographer, Christopher Wilder lured young women from shopping malls with promises of fame and fortune. Most ended up dead. As the FBI closed in around him, Wilder took off on a cross-country murderous rampage. The FBI added Wilder to their Most Wanted Fugitives program. The chase was on, and Wilder ultimately lost.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her 10 year-old son was missing from his school. No one knew how it could have happened. Within hours, the boy's entire family was frantically searching for him. The few leads in the case quickly turned cold and the FBI was called in to aid in the investigation. The search by agents and local authorities would cover a thousand miles to expose the kidnapper and find the missing child.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Kokomo, Indiana an unthinkable crime terrified residents. A young woman was snatched from her home on a bright spring morning. Drops of blood and a torn window screen were all that was left to tell authorities what happened to the twenty-one year old victim. After several days of searching, a former FBI profiler narrowed the suspect list to one. Agents and detectives followed the trail across state lines hoping to find the victim before her time ran out.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Arizona, a shipment of money vanished into the high desert, along with the two men hired to guard it. The FBI didn't know if the guards were participants or victims of an ambush. Answers lay somewhere in the thousands of square miles of Arizona's northwest territory. When the vehicle was recovered with three hundred thousand dollars and the drivers missing, suspicions that the crime was an inside job grew.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Beginning in summer of 1990, the bodies of several women began turning up in and around the city of Vienna, Austria. From an extensive investigation by the Viennese police, it was determined that these murders were the work of one sadistic predator. Europe was dealing with a serial killer. With no experience with this kind of predator, Viennese police turned to the FBI. FBI profilers were able to identify a suspect in the murders. More ominously, they linked this same killer to murders committed in the United States.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: At 9:30 am on the morning of January 30, 1997, Richmond, VA police respond to a report of shots fired at a local bank. Two masked men brandishing automatic weapons confront, and open fire on officers responding to the call. The gunmen exit the bank, and retreat on foot, eventually eluding the officers. The FBI soon responds, only to find one bank teller dead, another wounded, and the bank's security guard shot four times, yet still alive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Henderson, NV, a suburb of Las Vegas, two robbers brandishing assault rifles ambush armored guards as they exit their truck on March 3, 2000. The robbers kill both guards and seize $5,000. As the killers run to their getaway car, a police officer arrives and opens fire, striking one escaping assailant in the leg. After loosing the killers in a chase, police collect blood left by the injured robber and bullet casings from the firefight.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: By December 1985, John Gotti had assumed his place as the new Don of the Gambino crime family in New York with the assassination of his boss, Paul Castellano. The Teflon Don felt secure in his position, always remaining one step ahead of the law. But he was also the ongoing obsession of Bruce Mouw, leader of an elite crew of FBI agents formed to bring down the Gambino family. With the help and genius of his Special Projects Squad, bugs were planted in Gotti's most private meeting places.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Larry Horn nearly got away with the perfect crime: a multiple murder-for-hire plot that was meticulously planned and executed. Horn's former wife, their 8-year-old son, and a live-in nurse were all brutally murdered by an assassin. In the absence of any significant clues, police in Maryland contacted the FBI to assist in the investigation.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A cunning predator was loose in rural South Carolinaabducting young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was also a sadist, calling one victim's family, taunting them, boosting and then dashing their hopes. Local investigators called on the FBI to help them find this clever serial killer. Like a game of chess, FBI profilers and forensic examiners were able to outwit the killer, and put an end to his deadly game of cat and mouse.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Local law enforcement became stumped when the body of an unidentified young woman turned up on a highway in their small Pennsylvania town. They turned to the FBI labs. The hi-tech lab enabled investigators and agents to identify the victim. Knowing who she was allowed agents to reconstruct her every move. Though the road to finding her killer was twisted and long, agents persisted.

677011.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
677011.description: In tonight's programme Gordon finds a chef caught in a time warp when he tackles a picturesque but largely unfrequented upmarket restaurant in King's Lynn, a traditional market town on the Norfolk coast. For the last eighteen months ex Michelin-starred chef Nick has owned and run Rococo but his past success is now eluding him. The menu is past its sell-by date, the service is stuffy, the food is over-priced and the only thing being fed is his ego. Yet, despite debts of ~£100k and the prospect of putting his home at risk and his young family on the streets, Nick continues to cook comatose in a 1990s fantasy land of his own making.

677011.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
677011.description: In tonight's final programme of the series Gordon grapples with girl power when he takes on an intimate family-run restaurant in the heart of WAG territory near Liverpool. For the last three years Morgan's has been run by antiques dealer-turned-restaurateur SANDY and her two daughters HELEN and LAURA. The beautifully-designed dining room has a prime high street location and should be the perfect eatery for the trendy local clientele. But Head Chef Phil is grappling with an eclectic menu that includes mashed potato with apricots and his cooking's just not up to it.

abcsydney.au.description: S40 E6 Surviving Gaza, Seeking Truth In this highly personal story, Palestinian Australian journalist Patrick Abboud connects with Palestinian journalists now living in Australia, including Sameh, a camera operator who has lost family members in Gaza.

abcsydney.au.title: Songs of Praise
abcsydney.au.description: 200 Years of the RSPCA To celebrate the RSPCA's 200th anniversary, Rev. Kate Bottley visits an animal hospital in Birmingham. In the cat ward, Kate meets the charity's CEO Chris Sherwood to hear the remarkable story of how the RSPCA was founded.

actionmax.us.title: The Transporter Refueled
actionmax.us.description: Frank Martin is living a less perilous lifestyle, or so he thinks, transporting classified packages for questionable people. Things get complicated when femme fatale Anna and her three accomplices orchestrate a bank heist and the kidnapping of Frank's father. It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

actionmax.us.title: Trap
actionmax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Repo Men
actionmax.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

actionmax.us.title: The Mountain Between Us
actionmax.us.description: Stranded on a mountain after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must work together to endure the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles of wilderness, pushing each other to survive and discovering their inner strength. (Adventure, Drama, Romance) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
actionmax.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime drama) - 1999

actionmax.us.title: Ricochet
actionmax.us.description: After tracking down and arresting Earl Talbot Blake (John Lithgow), a psychotic hit man, rookie Los Angeles police officer Nick Styles (Denzel Washington) is hailed as a hero. Several years later, Styles' life appears perfect: He has married his girlfriend, started a family and risen to the position of assistant district attorney. However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge. (Action) - 1991

actionmax.us.title: A History of Violence
actionmax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

actionmax.us.title: Chasing Mavericks
actionmax.us.description: When 15-year-old surfing phenomenon Jay Moriarty discovers that the mythic Mavericks surf break, one of the biggest waves on Earth, actually exists near his California home, he becomes determined to conquer it. Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives. (Docudrama, Adventure) - 2012

actionmax.us.title: All Eyez on Me
actionmax.us.description: The true and untold story of prolific rapper, actor, poet and activist Tupac Shakur (Demetrius Shipp Jr.), from his early days in New York to his status as one of the world's most recognized and influential voices. Against all odds, Shakur's raw talent, powerful lyrics and revolutionary mindset establish him as a cultural icon whose legacy continues to grow long after his death. (Biography, Drama, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Robin Hood
actionmax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

actionmax.us.title: Nerve
actionmax.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime drama) - 2016

actionmax.us.title: Little Shop of Horrors
actionmax.us.description: Meek flower shop assistant Seymour (Rick Moranis) pines for co-worker Audrey (Ellen Greene). During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. (Musical comedy) - 1986

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
actionmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
actionmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

amccanada.ca.title: The Amityville Horror
amccanada.ca.description: When George Lutz (Ryan Reynolds) and his wife, Kathy (Melissa George), find a beautiful new house in the small town of Amityville, N.Y., they think the place is too good to be true. After they move in with their kids, they find out the cheap price tag is thanks to the house's sordid history: The former tenant murdered his family after supposedly being possessed by the devil. Believing the home is haunted, the couple find a priest (Philip Baker Hall) to help them rid the place of evil spirits. (Horror) - 2005

amccanada.ca.title: The Amityville Horror
amccanada.ca.description: Chiller about a family who is terrorized by supernatural forces when they move into a new house in New York State which was the scene of a recent mass killing and the home of an 18th-century satanist. When swarms of flies appear from nowhere and the pipes and walls begin to ooze slime and blood, they call on a local priest to exorcize the evil spirits. (Horror) - 1979

amccanada.ca.title: Motel Hell
amccanada.ca.description: Vincent Smith (Rory Calhoun) and his sister Ida (Nancy Parsons) run a rural hotel, but they earn most of their cash operating a food stand that specializes in world-famous sausages. After years of success, however, the duo's upstanding brother, Sheriff Bruce (Paul Linke), eventually discovers the grotesque details of his siblings' booming business: Vincent and Ida are actually plumping up their hotel patrons, killing and dismembering them and then grinding them into frankfurters. (Horror, Dark comedy) - 1980

amccanada.ca.title: The Shining
amccanada.ca.description: Jack Torrance (Jack Nicholson) becomes winter caretaker at the isolated Overlook Hotel in Colorado, hoping to cure his writer's block. He settles in along with his wife, Wendy (Shelley Duvall), and his son, Danny (Danny Lloyd), who is plagued by psychic premonitions. As Jack's writing goes nowhere and Danny's visions become more disturbing, Jack discovers the hotel's dark secrets and begins to unravel into a homicidal maniac hell-bent on terrorizing his family. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

amccanada.ca.title: Graveyard Shift
amccanada.ca.description: After an abandoned textile mill reopens, several employees die; the deaths occur between 11 p.m. and 7 a.m. during the graveyard shift. A mill foreman assigns a group to clean the basement; the workers find a network of tunnels leading to a cemetery and an unknown creature. (Holiday, Horror) - 1990

amccanada.ca.title: Pet Sematary
amccanada.ca.description: Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient. (Horror, Thriller) - 1989

amccanada.ca.title: Silver Bullet
amccanada.ca.description: When a series of unexplained murders occurs in the normally quiet town of Tarker's Mill, the residents decide to hunt down the killer. However, many of these vigilantes end up dead, and those who don't are any closer to finding an assailant. But, when a young wheelchair-using boy named Marty encounters a werewolf one night, the pieces begin to come together. Along with his sister and Uncle Red, Marty begins a mission to capture the werewolf once and for all. (Horror) - 1985

amccanada.ca.title: Christine
amccanada.ca.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

amccanada.ca.title: Rosemary's Baby
amccanada.ca.description: A young wife comes to believe that her offspring is not of this world. Waifish Rosemary Woodhouse and her struggling actor husband Guy move to a New York City apartment building with an ominous reputation and odd neighbors Roman and Minnie Castevet. When Rosemary becomes pregnant, she becomes increasingly isolated, and the diabolical truth is revealed only after Rosemary gives birth. (Horror) - 1968
