showtimewest.us.title: Dunkirk
showtimewest.us.description: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found.

showtimewest.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
showtimewest.us.description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child.

showtimewest.us.title: Argo
showtimewest.us.description: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

showtimewest.us.title: V for Vendetta
showtimewest.us.description: After world war leads to a fascist government, a vigilante known as V (Hugo Weaving) uses terrorist tactics to fight the totalitarian state in which he now lives.

showtimewest.us.title: Sleeping Dogs
showtimewest.us.description: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

showtimewest.us.title: Gangs of New York
showtimewest.us.description: During the era of Tammany Hall's sway, a young man (Leonardo DiCaprio) vows vengeance on the vicious gangster (Daniel Day-Lewis) who killed his father.

showtimewest.us.title: Paycheck
showtimewest.us.description: After learning that his memory has been erased, a technical wizard (Ben Affleck) goes on the run to piece together clues from his past.

showtimewest.us.title: Jack Reacher
showtimewest.us.description: A defense attorney hires an enigmatic ex-Army investigator to tackle the case of a highly trained sniper who apparently murdered five people at random.

showtimewest.us.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
showtimewest.us.description: Investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) goes on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers.

showtimewest.us.title: Edge of Tomorrow
showtimewest.us.description: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.

showtimewest.us.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
showtimewest.us.description: An Army agent (Martin Sheen) goes upriver into the heart of Cambodia to kill a renegade colonel (Marlon Brando).

showtimewest.us.title: My Cousin Vinny
showtimewest.us.description: Two New Yorkers accused of murder in rural Alabama while on their way back to college call in the help of one of their cousins, a loudmouth lawyer with no trial experience.

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: Mean Girls
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: Cady Heron enrolls at North Shore High School near Chicago after living in Africa. She interacts with Regina George, a prominent student who previously dated Aaron Samuels. Conflict arises when Heron develops an interest in Samuels, leading George to feign a friendship with Heron while attempting to maintain her relationship with Samuels. Both students engage in competitive social behavior that affects the student body. (Comedy) - 2004

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: She's All That
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: High school hotshot Zach Siler (Freddie Prinze Jr.) is the envy of his peers. But his popularity declines sharply when his cheerleader girlfriend, Taylor (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), leaves him for sleazy reality-television star Brock Hudson (Matthew Lillard). Desperate to revive his fading reputation, Siler agrees to a seemingly impossible challenge. He has six weeks to gain the trust of nerdy outcast Laney Boggs (Rachael Leigh Cook) -- and help her to become the school's next prom queen. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 1999

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: Beastly
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: After a spurned classmate curses him, a teen will be forever ugly unless he finds love. (Fantasy, Romance, Drama) - 2011

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: An Unfinished Life
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. (Drama) - 2005

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: Walking Out
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear. (Adventure, Drama) - 2017

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: Where the Wild Things Are
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: Feeling misunderstood at home and at school, mischievous Max (Max Records) escapes to the land of the Wild Things, majestic -- and sometimes fierce -- creatures. They allow Max to become their leader, and he promises to create a kingdom where everyone will be happy. However, Max soon finds that being king is not easy and that, even being with the Wild Things, there is something missing. (Children, Fantasy, Adventure) - 2009

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: Yours, Mine & Ours
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: When Coast Guard Adm. Frank Beardsley (Dennis Quaid) decides to move his family of eight children back to his old hometown, he encounters handbag designer Helen North (Rene Russo), an old flame from high school. Immediately, sparks fly between the two, and marriage is proposed. But Frank isn't the only one with kids to worry about -- Helen has a total of 10. Right away, the children have no intention of playing nicely, and together they decide to sabotage their parents' relationship. (Children, Comedy) - 2005

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: Living in exile on the planet Vulcan, the ragtag former crew of the USS Enterprise steal a starship after receiving a planetary distress call from Earth: a space probe has entered into orbit around Earth, disabled global power on the planet and evaporated the oceans. Captain Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the rest of the officers travel back in time to retrieve now-extinct humpback whales, which Spock has deduced will communicate with the probe and send it away from Earth. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Comedy, Drama) - 1986

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2017

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: Grumpy Old Men
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: John Gustafson (Jack Lemmon) and Max Goldman (Walter Matthau) are two curmudgeonly neighbors who have been at each other's throats for years. The rivalry of the former friends intensifies when Ariel (Ann-Margret) comes along and provides a love interest for both of them. When Max finds out that John is experiencing family troubles and financial ruin, however, he steps in to help. Their bond is further cemented when John has a health scare and Max makes the ultimate sacrifice for his friend. (Comedy) - 1993

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: Addams Family Values
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: The members of the odd Addams Family are up to more macabre antics in this sequel. This time around, Gomez Addams (Raul Julia) and his wife, Morticia (Anjelica Huston), are celebrating the arrival of a baby boy. But siblings Wednesday (Christina Ricci) and Pugsley (Jimmy Workman) are none too happy about the new addition, and try their best to eliminate the infant. When nanny Debbie Jellinsky (Joan Cusack) appears to keep the kids in line, her presence leads to an unexpected treacherous twist. (Dark comedy, Fantasy) - 1993

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: Free Birds
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: Pardoned by the president, a lucky turkey (Owen Wilson) named Reggie gets to live a carefree lifestyle, until fellow fowl Jake (Woody Harrelson) recruits him for a history-changing mission. Jake and Reggie travel back in time to the year 1621, just before the first Thanksgiving. The plan: Prevent all turkeys from ever becoming holiday dinners. Unfortunately, the two birds encounter colonist Myles Standish (Colm Meaney), out to capture feathered friends for all the hungry Pilgrims. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 2013

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: Hotel Transylvania
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: Dracula becomes overprotective when a human boy discovers his monsters-only resort during a birthday celebration and falls for his teenage daughter. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2012

showtimefamilyzone.us.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
showtimefamilyzone.us.description: Now that Dracula has opened the Hotel Transylvania's doors to humans, things are changing for the better; however, Drac is secretly worried that his half-human grandson, Dennis, isn't showing his vampire side. So, while Mavis and Johnny are away, Drac enlists his friends to help him put the boy through a "monster-in-training" boot camp. But things really get batty when Drac's cantankerous, old-school dad pays an unexpected visit. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2015

retroplex.us.title: In Old Caliente
retroplex.us.description: In California, Roy (Roy Rogers) works on the large ranch of Don Jose (Frank Puglia), one of the last of the major Spanish landowners. The foreman of the ranch, Saguaro (Jack LaRue), is involved with a gang of bandits and hopes to pit the newly arriving Americans against the dwindling Spanish and native populations. Saguaro becomes Roy's nemesis, getting him banished from the ranch and framing him for various crimes, but Roy concocts an audacious plan to clear his name. (Western) - 1939

retroplex.us.title: Stagecoach Outlaws
retroplex.us.description: Cowboy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) enrages saloon owner Steve Kirby (Stanford Jolley) when he thwarts a bank robbery by Kirby's crew. But Kirby has more schemes up his sleeve. He sends his men to bust brutish outlaw Matt Brawley (Bob Kortman) out of jail for a new heist. When a case of mistaken identities leads to the bandits freeing harmless Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) instead, he decides to play along to help Billy. However, the real Brawley soon arrives to cause trouble. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Lightning Raiders
retroplex.us.description: When his mail doesn't get delivered one day, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is suspicious. He enlists the help of his friend Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) to find out what happened. The duo discovers that the postal stagecoach has been held up by Frank Hayden (Steve Darrell) and his band of thieves, and that the criminals are in hiding. It's up to Fuzzy and Billy to stop the thieves before they make off with the stolen mail -- and with the money and secrets that it contains. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Don Ricardo Returns
retroplex.us.description: Two years after being forcibly taken away from his California property by thugs working for his greedy cousin, Luerra (Anthony Warde), Don Ricardo (Fred Coby) returns to reclaim his ranch and his fiancée, Dorothea (Isabelita). After meeting old friend Lugo the Huge (Paul Newlan) in a cantina, Don Ricardo takes the advice of Padre Carlos (David Leonard) and gets a job on his land, disguised as a common laborer, biding his time until he can find evidence of Luerra's wrongdoing and challenge him. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Stranger
retroplex.us.description: Immediately following World War II, ex-Nazi Franz Kindler is living under a false identity as a teacher in a small Connecticut town, and has even married the headmaster's daughter as part of his cover. But when one of Kindler's old German associates arrives unexpectedly in town, bringing in his wake a sly federal investigator, Kindler resorts to desperate measures to preserve his secret. (Thriller) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
retroplex.us.description: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court. (Biography, Historical drama) - 1988

retroplex.us.title: Battle Ground

retroplex.us.title: Double Whammy

A pair of screenwriters (Donald Faison, Keith Nobbs) across the hall keep bugging him for help. The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). retroplex.us.title: The Promise
retroplex.us.description: Brilliant medical student Michael (Oscar Isaac) meets beautiful dance instructor Ana (Charlotte Le Bon) in late 1914. 365blk.us.title: Lethal Weapon
365blk.us.description: Following the death of his wife, Los Angeles police detective Martin Riggs (Mel Gibson) becomes reckless and suicidal. When he is reassigned and partnered with Roger Murtaugh (Danny Glover), Riggs immediately clashes with the older officer. Together they uncover a massive drug-trafficking ring. As they encounter increasingly dangerous situations, Riggs and Murtaugh begin to form a bond. Riggs' volatile behavior might just help them apprehend the criminals -- if it doesn't kill them both first. (Action, Thriller) - 1987

365blk.us.title: Lethal Weapon 2
365blk.us.description: South African smugglers find themselves being hounded and harassed by Riggs and Murtaugh, two mismatched Los Angeles police officers. However, the South Africans are protected by diplomatic immunity, and so the two are assigned to witness-protection duty in an attempt by their captain to keep his job. It is only when this witness reveals to them that he has already dealt with the smugglers that the trouble really starts. (Action, Thriller) - 1989

365blk.us.title: Super Fly
365blk.us.description: Priest (Ron O'Neal), a suave top-rung New York City drug dealer, decides that he wants to get out of his dangerous trade. Working with his reluctant friend, Eddie (Carl Lee), Priest devises a scheme that will allow him to make a big deal and then retire. When a desperate street dealer informs the police of Priest's activities, Priest is forced into an uncomfortable arrangement with corrupt narcotics officers. Setting his plan in motion, he aims to both leave the business and stick it to the man. (Crime drama) - 1972

365blk.us.title: TNT Jackson
365blk.us.description: A woman (Jeanne Bell) encounters thugs and drug dealers after traveling to Hong Kong to search for her missing brother. (Action, Martial arts) - 1974

365blk.us.title: Mean Johnny Barrows

365blk.us.title: Queen Sugar - With a Kind of
365blk.us.description: Nova updates the family on her new plans for the book, "Hollywood" and Violet progresses with fostering; Darla confronts a menacing phone call. (Drama) - 2022-10-04

365blk.us.title: For Colored Girls
365blk.us.description: In New York, a group of black women, most of whom live in the same Harlem apartment building, faces personal crises, heartbreak and other challenges. Crystal (Kimberly Elise) faces an unhappy existence as an abused lover. Jo (Janet Jackson) is a successful magazine editor, but her husband has a secret double life. Juanita (Loretta Devine) is a relationship counselor but cannot seem to get her love life in order. These three and others become bound together by their experiences. (Drama) - 2010

365blk.us.title: Moonfall
365blk.us.description: The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2022

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hit & Run
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down. (Comedy, Action, Adventure) - 2012

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Kill Switch
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A military experiment to harness unlimited energy goes horribly awry, leaving a pilot with no choice but to fight through an imploding world to save his family and the planet itself. (Family, Science fiction, Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Are You Here
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After his eccentric pal (Zach Galifianakis) inherits a fortune from his estranged father, an aimless, womanizing weatherman (Owen Wilson) becomes involved in the legal battle initiated by his friend's sister (Amy Poehler). (Comedy drama) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Jack's Back
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2004

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Baby Gone
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Emily, who is pregnant, quickly becomes friends with her new, pregnant neighbor. Little does Emily know that Kelly has been faking her pregnancy so she can steal her baby. (Thriller) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Chef
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. (Comedy drama) - 2014

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Crime drama, Romance) - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

fifthgear.us.description: Jonny Smith is in France, experiencing the world of Rallycross; a cross between rallying and circuit racing, where 650bhp machines battle door to door.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Jason Plato and Tiff Needell pit three petrolheads against new, mainstream cars to find out if the classics we lust after are outclassed by modern machines.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson tests the latest BMW X5 4.8i; it's an impressive machine, costing £50,000, it does 150mph; Jason Plato tests the ultimate track car, the brand-new Lotus 2 Eleven.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E10 Tom spends the day with the scourge of modern day motorists: wheel clampers; Vicki tests the Nissan 350Z.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E02 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if the new 207 GTI is as exhilarating to drive as the 20-year-old hot hatch, the 205 GTI; Fifth Gear conducts a fascinating world's first crash test - we crash a 15-year-old Volvo 940.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E03 Diesel Mini vs a gas one; comparing the new Subaru Impreza to a previous version.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E04 Checking police driving skills on a racetrack; testing small economy cars on one of Britain's biggest hills.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E05 Comparing Audi TT's semi-automatic gearbox vs a manual one.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E06 The BMW Z4 and Nissan 350Z go head-to-head on the track.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E07 Naming which TV cop car is fastest; celebrating the 75th anniversary of the Deuce Coupe; testing the Gumpert Apollo; building a drift car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E08 Tiff Needell gets behind the wheel of the cutting-edge Ferrari 430 Scuderia.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E09 A Lamborghini Gallardo Superleggera; a cider farmer who uses rotten apples to produce methane that powers his Jaguar.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E10 Iwan Thomas accepts a stunt challenge from precision driver Russ Swift; Jonny Smith secretly repairs potholes; Tom Ford drives a Monster.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E01 Vicki tests two cars, the Lotus Exige S vs. Caterham CSR; Tom visits Spain to drive the Toyota Land Cruiser; Jason Plato drives the Mercedes CLK63 Black; Tiff teaches Heston Blumenthal the art of power sliding.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E02 Tom gets an advance look at Formula 1 supremo Bernie Ecclestone's rare and unusual collection of cars; Tiff and Jason take the BMW M3 and the Mercedes C63 AMG to a circuit to determine which is most deserving of its £50,000 price tag.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E03 Vicki finds out which is quickest, an old Vauxhall against a new one; Jonny Smith and Tom Ford contest one of motor sport's oldest and most grueling events, the Exeter Trial; Tiff Needell goes to France to drive the new Audi A3 Cabriolet.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E04 Vicki tests the Mercedes Vito X or the VW Transporter Sportline on the track to find out which is quickest; Jonny embarks on the 600-mile transcontinental trip in the BMW 635d; Tom drives the ultimate 4x4, the 12-ton, 10-foot tall Unimog.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E05 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which is the fastest, the Renault Twingo GT or the Fiat Panda 100HP; Tiff Needell and Jason Plato go head-to-head; this time it's small coupes as the Porsche Cayman comes up against the new BMW 135i Coupe.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson is at Anglesey for another shoot-out; his time it's super chic superminis, the BMW Mini One against the Fiat 500; Jason Plato delivers his verdict on the Nissan Skyline now re-badged as the GT-R.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E07 Vicki is at the controls in a classic Ford v Vauxhall battle, two boy racer specials, the Fiesta ST and Corsa SRi, wage war to find out which is fastest; Tom journeys to the Arctic Circle to test the Volvo XC70, an estate car with four-wheel drive.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E08 Vicki Butler-Henderson is in Anglesey for another Fifth Gear shoot-out. This week it's the Porsche Cayenne GTS against the BMW X5. Tom Ford drives the new C5 and Tiff Needell tests the new Subaru Impreza STi.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which is quickest, the VW Golf GTI or Subaru Impreza WRX; Jonny Smith proves there are still some cars that you can buy for under $1,500.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E10 Vicki takes the Focus RS and the Escort Cosworth to find out once and for all which handles best around a track; Jason drives the Grand Tourer and delivers his verdict whether the £78,000 asking price would represent money well spent.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E01 Tim Shaw joins the team, and he's been specially tasked with standing up for the beleaguered motorist; Jason Plato and Tiff Needell go head-to-head on the track to find out which car is fastest.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E02 Tiff Needell takes two coupes onto the Fifth Gear track, the Mazda RX8 and Nissan 350Z; Vicki Butler-Henderson spends a day with Formula One star Lewis Hamilton; Tom Ford is the lucky man behind the wheel of the facelifted Mercedes SL63 AMG.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E03 Jason Plato races two estates head to head; Vicki Butler-Henderson pits the new Pro-Ceed against the VW Golf; Jonny Smith picks up an amazing luxury car for £1000 or less; Tiff Needell runs the most exciting car vs. bike race to date.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E04 Jason Plato pitches a lunatic Honda Civic Mugen RR imported from Japan against a Honda S2000 sports car from the UK; Jonny Smith tests the VW Passat CC v Mercedes CLS; Tiff Needell takes to the track to test the brand new KTM X-Bow.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E05 Tiff and Jason race two V8 mega-saloons. Tom has the only television test of the Dodge Challenger.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 A Modern Home and Rental Chrissy's multipurpose home needs help to be as vibrant as Chrissy and her podcast with Marie, while Raymond has a house to sell that needs staging in a hurry.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 A Dream Childhood Home Lauren's childhood home needs big help to become the grown up family home for her, Kyle and their two boys, while real estate agent Odane needs expert staging to help his clients sell high, and buy their dream home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E06 Creative Lounge Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Tropical Family Resort Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E01 A Space For Dancing and Hanging Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E07 Luxury Staycation Since having two kids, Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home, but their backyard is a headache. Brian and Sarah create a luxury vacation destination that includes a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Craft Studio Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Inspiring Cake Studio Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 Cottage in the City Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E04 Stained Glass Studio Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Gentleman's Gym Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E13 Hillside Playhouse Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property
shadesofblack.us.description: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash). (Crime drama) - 2002

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property 2
shadesofblack.us.description: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone. (Crime drama) - 2005

shadesofblack.us.title: The Island
shadesofblack.us.description: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise. (Drama, Action, Thriller) - 2023

shadesofblack.us.title: The Inspection
shadesofblack.us.description: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, even as he battles deep-seated prejudice and the grueling rigor of basic training, he finds unexpected camaraderie, strength and support in this new community, giving him a hard-won sense of belonging that shapes his identity and forever changes his life. (Drama, LGBTQ) - 2022

shadesofblack.us.title: As Good as Dead
shadesofblack.us.description: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind. (Action) - 2022

shadesofblack.us.title: Triple Threat
shadesofblack.us.description: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target. (Action, Martial arts) - 2019

shadesofblack.us.title: The Mighty Quinn
shadesofblack.us.description: Police chief Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) investigates the gruesome murder of Donald Pater, one of the wealthiest residents on a Caribbean island. He was found decapitated in his Jacuzzi. Although the local political establishment, especially crooked Governor Chalk (Norman Beaton), insists that small-time thief Maubee (Robert Townsend) is responsible, Xavier has his doubts. This view is complicated by the police chief's personal history with Maubee: The men have been friends since childhood. (Mystery) - 1989

shadesofblack.us.title: Fifty Shades of Black
shadesofblack.us.description: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," Hannah Steele interviews entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) for her roommate's school newspaper. The wealthy and eligible Black quickly learns how clumsy the young woman is. As flirtation leads to attraction, Christian invites Hannah to his home and introduces her to his kinky world of S&M. Despite their different backgrounds, the new couple consistently surprise each other with how far they're willing to go to make their relationship work. (Comedy) - 2016

shadesofblack.us.title: Meet the Blacks
shadesofblack.us.description: When some unexpected money comes his way, Carl Black moves his family from cold and windy Chicago to bright and sunny Beverly Hills, Calif. As the Blacks settle into their beautiful new home, they start to notice some strange behavior in the neighborhood. Nighttime is approaching, and President El bama announces that the annual purge is about to begin. truehistory.us.title: The Big History of Civilizations - The Rise of Humanity
truehistory.us.description: Tracing the origins of the human species from the emergence of proto-humans to the rise of Homo sapiens, Professor Benjamin offers perspectives to show what makes the human species unique and why it has been able to flourish. (World history) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: Discovering West Africa: Ghana, Senegal, Cameroon - Made in Ghana
truehistory.us.description: Ghana is blessed with a vibrant culture and a scenic coastline. (Travel) - 2023-01-27

truehistory.us.title: Discovering West Africa: Ghana, Senegal, Cameroon - Ghanaian Botanical Gardens, Afropop, and Yoga
truehistory.us.description: To fully experience Ghana, explorers must spend time with local musicians and take a nature hike. (Travel) - 2023-01-27

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: A Guided Tour of Ancient Egypt - Exploring the Gift of the Nile
truehistory.us.description: For the ancient Egyptians, the Nile is the source of all life; Egypt's ancient cities and monuments; the rich pantheon of Egyptian gods; the role of Egyptian kings as divine intermediaries; the symbolism of Egyptian architecture, art and ritual. (Travel) - 2021-05-12

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: A Guided Tour of Ancient Egypt - The Major Museums of Cairo
truehistory.us.description: Using objects from Cairo's three great museums; tracing 5,000 years of Egyptian history; Narmer Palette sets the conventions for Egyptian art; what a statue of King Khafre and Tutankhamun's golden throne tell about Egypt from various periods. (Travel) - 2021-05-12

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - Star-Spangled Banner - Inspiring the Anthem
truehistory.us.description: A tour of national treasures from the Smithsonian; the artifact that inspires the national anthem; the flag that flows over Fort McHenry when Francis Scott Key pens "The Star-Spangled Banner"; the battle for the fort and the history of the flag. (Travel) - 2014-08-22

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - Presidents and Generals - Images of Leadership
truehistory.us.description: How some of the country's greatest leaders have seen themselves and been seen by the nation; Washington's uniform, swords and portraits; notable photographs of Lincoln; the history of Eisenhower's distinctive army jacket and his presidential look. (Travel) - 2014-08-22

truehistory.us.title: America's Founding Fathers - George Washington's Doubts
truehistory.us.description: Explaining the importance of getting a well-rounded understanding of the Founders; Professor Guelzo explores Washington's fears about post-Revolutionary America; Washington's concerns about how people could administer their own affairs. (American history) - 2017-03-31

truehistory.us.title: America's Founding Fathers - Thomas Mifflin's Congress
truehistory.us.description: Before the ratification of the Constitution, there are presidents of the Congress created by the Articles of Confederation; the failures of one president, Thomas Mifflin, offer a window into the problems facing the United States of America in 1783. (American history) - 2017-03-31

truehistory.us.title: The Historical Jesus - The Many Faces of Jesus
truehistory.us.description: Scholars who have devoted their lives to studying the ancient sources about Jesus come to varying conclusions; seeing what can be learned about what Jesus most likely says and does by working from a strictly historical perspective. (Educational, Religious) - 2000-07-18

truehistory.us.title: The Historical Jesus - One Remarkable Life
truehistory.us.description: Beginning the study of the historical Jesus by examining the world within which the Christian religion is born; this world is largely populated by "pagans" who, unlike the Jews and then later the Christians, believe not in one but in many gods. (Educational, Religious) - 2000-07-18

truehistory.us.title: The US Constitution through History - America's Founding Ideas
truehistory.us.description: Start the course on the U.S. Constitution by learning about the English culture that inspired American law and the conflict with England that caused the revolution. (American history) - 2023-11-23

truehistory.us.title: The US Constitution through History - Failures of Early American Governments
truehistory.us.description: Consider where the Articles of Confederation came from. (American history)

truehistory.us.title: Early Humans: Ice, Stone, and Survival - What Does It Mean to Be Human?
truehistory.us.description: Exploring human development and the considering questions about early life. (World history) - 2023-04-21

truehistory.us.title: Early Humans: Ice, Stone, and Survival - Stones and Bones: The First Fossil Families
truehistory.us.description: Homo habilis, the earliest known species of the genus. (World history) - 2023-04-21

truehistory.us.title: The Big History of Civilizations - A Tale of Two Ancient Cities
truehistory.us.description: Jericho and Anau are two of the world's oldest cities; their stories have much to say about the scope of human history; what makes these cities successful; how they differ from each other; introducing the concept and key themes of Big History. Featured Superstars include Roman Reigns, Hulk Hogan, Undertaker, John Cena, Becky Lynch, The New Day, Alexa Bliss, Drew McIntyre, The Rock, "Macho Man" Randy Savage, Charlotte Flair and more. thisoldhouse.us.description: S35 E06 Jersey Shore: Go With the Flow A natural barrier island; in Point Pleasant, Carlos removes siding, fits hurricane strapping, and pours a slab; insulated CMU "breakaway wall" panels; bringing back Jersey Shore landscapes after Sandy; the progress on Rita's modular Cape.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S35 E07 Jersey Shore: Stories From Sea Level Getting a lesson in surfing; the Bay Head house is lifted to its final height; complications of trying to pour footings at sea level; why fiber cement siding makes sense; installing composite decking; the punch list is completed.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S35 E08 Jersey Shore: One Year Later A year after Sandy, Norm and Kevin take stock of recovery at the Jersey Shore; Richard visits Mantoloking to see a house that survived a breach; Kevin checks out the Point Pleasant project; Richard finds a landscaper planting some container gardens.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S35 E09 Arlington Italianate: A New Project A modest 1872 Italianate-style remodel in Arlington, Mass.; the homeowners want to open up the floor plan and make a bigger kitchen; they plan to create a master suite; the challenges of foundation work; a host of issues in finishing the basement.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S35 E10 Arlington Italianate: Old House Discoveries Richard investigates an Arlington Heights landmark; back at the house, Tom shows Kevin a hidden back staircase, ceiling height, and decent framing; second-floor joists in the former full bath are badly compromised, and the old stairs need removal.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S35 E11 Arlington Italianate: Concrete Jungle Tom doing more demo; Mark McCullough is ready to get the new foundation going and Kevin lends a hand; the pitched floor and ledge are dug and cut out to make room for a level floor; a concrete curb; Tom and Kevin make a breathtaking discovery.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S35 E12 Arlington Italianate: Quest for a Dry Basement Tom frames the new roof; to repair and repoint the failing brick foundation, something is added to keep water at bay. Roger meets a landscape architect to see an Italianate Garden; Norm helps Tom cut through the wall for the new mudroom entrance.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S35 E13 Arlington Italianate: Getting to Level The new floor plan; explaining the system to ensure a flat ceiling in the kitchen; leveling out the existing concrete floor; options for the front yard; reviewing shade gardens, woodland paths and hardscape options; window openings.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E11 Walkway; Mead; Wiring Roger rips up an old, dangerous walkway to replace it with bluestone; Scott explains the best wire nuts to use for each project; Kevin gets a lesson on making mead.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E12 Heating; Hand Saw; LED An environmentally safe way to keep walkways safe during the winter; showing how and when to use hand saws; helping a homeowner diagnose a problem with a hot water radiator; installing thin LED lights underneath the overhang of a homeowner's garage.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E13 Garden; Shed; Stains Landscape designer Jenn Nawada learns about rooftop and small space gardens; Tom explains the best practices to remove stains from plaster and drywall; Scott helps a homeowner power his shed by running electricity underground from his house.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation

classica.us.title: Mozart, Mendelssohn und Gershwin für 2 Klaviere
classica.us.description: Zwei italienische Pianisten interpretieren gemeinsam Mozarts Klaviersonate in D für zwei Klaviere, Mendelssohns Klaviersonate für zwei Klaviere in D und Gershwins "Rhapsody in Blue" in einem Konzertprogramm aus dem Fazioli-Saal in Sacile. (Special, Music) - 2021-02-13

classica.us.title: Modena - Stadt von Belcanto
classica.us.description: Die Studenten von Raina Kabaivanska beschäftigen sich mit dem Diptychon von Menotti in Modena. (Special, Documentary, Music, Classical) - 2018-03-27

classica.us.title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
classica.us.description: In den 1980-er Jahren schuf Philip Glass Musik nach dem Werk "Descent into the Maelstrom" des amerikanischen Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe. Die Kurzgeschichte handelt von zwei Fischern, die in Sturzbächen in den Lofoten gefangen sind. (Special, Documentary, Music) - 2019-02-10

classica.us.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op.12
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung vom Verbier Festival von 2018 zollt Seong-Jin Cho Claude Debussy Tribut anlässlich seines 100. Geburtstags. Auf dem Programm stehen Schumanns Fantasiestücke op. 12, die nur selten in Konzertprogrammen zu hören sind. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2021-05-29

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: IVC 2019 - Finale: Duparc, Borodin et al
classica.us.description: Die Mezzosopranistin Esther Valentin und die Pianistin Anastasia Grishutina führen Henri Duparcs "L'invitation au voyage" auf. Diese Aufführung wurde im Theater aan de Parade in 's-Hertogenbosch, Niederlande, aufgenommen. (Music, Classical) - 2023-04-10

classica.us.title: Mozart - Sinfonie Nr. 34, K. 338
classica.us.description: Der Maestro Iván Fischer dirigiert das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem fesselnden Konzertprogramm mit Werken von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart und Antonín Dvořák. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur. (Special, Event) - 2025-06-04

classica.us.title: Griegs Klavierkonzert & Beethovens Sinfonie Nr. 7
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flandern Symphonieorchester in einem Konzert, aufgenommen im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, am 21. April 2016. Das Programm beginnt mit Felix Mendelssohns Konzertouvertüre Die Hebriden, Op. 26. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-02-10

classica.us.title: Dupré - Variationen über zwei Themen, Op. 35
classica.us.description: Alessandro Marangoni und Paolo Oreni präsentieren Marcel Duprés Variationen über zwei Themen für Klavier und Orgel, Op. 35. Diese beeindruckende Darbietung wurde am 5. April 2024 in der Fabbrica Poggi in Pavia, Italien, aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-12-01

classica.us.title: Die drei Leben der Clara Schumann
classica.us.description: Die Biografie von Clara Schumann ist legendenumwoben: Ihre strenge Kindheit, ihr außergewöhnliches Talent als Pianistin, ihre frühe Liebe zum Komponisten Robert Schumann und die Erziehung von sieben Kindern bieten Material für Mythen und Klischees. (Special, Documentary) - 2019-09-15

classica.us.title: Schumann: Humoreske, Op. 20
classica.us.description: In der Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz die Humoreske in B-Dur, Op. 20. Schumann komponierte das Werk im Jahr 1839 und widmete es Julie von Webenau. Der Titel des Werks bezieht sich auf die ältere Bedeutung von Humor als emotionaler Zustand. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-12-19

classica.us.title: Händel, Der Messias
classica.us.description: Aus dem Theater an der Wien: das Oratorium "Der Messias" von Georg Friedrich Händel (1685-1759) in szenischer Form. Musikalische Leitung: Jean-Christophe Spinosi - Inszenierung: Claus Guth. Mit Susan Gritton (Sopran), Bejun Mehta (Altus), Richard Croft (Tenor), Florian Boesch (Bass), Arnold-Schönberg-Chor, Ensemble Matheus. In seiner Inszenierung zeigt Claus Guth neue, zusätzliche Sichtweisen auf die Handlung um Jesus Christus und auf Fragen um Tod, Verlust, Trauer und Hoffnung. (Special, Music) - 2012-12-23

classica.us.title: The Pianists Keys
classica.us.description: Der Film berichtet über zwei junge Pianisten an der Internationalen Klavierakademie im Engadin. (Special, Documentary, Music) - 2021-01-04

classica.us.title: Beethoven, Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37
classica.us.description: Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37. Yefim Bronfman (Klavier), Staatskapelle Dresden, Leitung: Christian Thielemann. Aufgenommen in der Semperoper Dresden. Beethovens Ausdrucksmittel für Sturm und Drang war c-Moll: In dieser Tonart schrieb er seine dramatischsten und heroischsten Werke, darunter die 5. Symphonie und die Klaviersonate op. 13, seine berühmte "Pathétique". (Special, Entertainment, Music, Classical) - 2017-03-27

classica.us.title: Schumann - Novelletten, op. 21
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Novelletten, Op. 21. Die acht Stücke für Klavier, die diesen Liederzyklus ausmachen, werden oft einzeln aufgeführt. Es trägt eine Widmung an den Pianisten Adolph Henselt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-01-23

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 2
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs Reihe der sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte gehört zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Zu ihrem 300-jährigen Jubiläum im Jahr 2021 spielten Václav Luks und das renommierte Barockensemble Collegium 1704 alle sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-04

classica.us.title: Mahler - 9. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Das Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester wurde im Jahr 1986 gegründet. Heute zählt es zu den besten Jugendorchestern weltweit. Es wurde auf Claudio Abbados Initiative gegründet. Das Repertoire des Orchesters ist stark vom Werk Gustav Mahlers geprägt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-04-09

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 8
classica.us.description: Mahlers 8. Symphonie, auch bekannt als die Symphonie der Tausend, ist ein monumentales Chor-Epos aus dem Jahr 1906, das ein riesiges Ensemble aus Solisten, Chören und einem gewaltigen Orchester erfordert. (Special) - 2026-03-28

classica.us.title: Waltons Bratschenkonzert & Brahms' Sinfonie Nr. 4
classica.us.description: Robin Ticciati dirigiert das London Symphony Orchestra in Waltons Violakonzert und Brahms' Symphonie Nr. 4. Antoine Tamestit spielt als Solist, während das Konzert das jugendliche Genie Waltons und die leidenschaftliche Tiefe von Brahms vereint. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-10-18

classica.us.title: Schubert - Vier Impromptus, op. 90 - I
classica.us.description: Roberto Prosseda spielt Mozarts fünfte Klaviersonate und vier Impromptus, Op. 90 von Franz Schubert. Prosseda bringt das Konzert mit einer Interpretation der technisch anspruchsvollen Ballade No. 4, Op. 52 von Chopin zu einem krönenden Abschluss. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-12-15

classica.us.title: Bach - 2. Partita für Violin (BWV 1004)
classica.us.description: Die deutsche Geigerin Isabelle Faust spielt dieses Mal zwei beeindruckende Solowerke für die Violine. So spielt sie von Johann Sebastian Bach die Partita Nummer 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 sowie auch die Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. (Special, Music, Event) - 2023-06-01

itvmeridian.uk.title: The Last Samurai (2003)
itvmeridian.uk.description: Civil War soldier Nathan Algren leaves the USA for feudal Japan. After signing up to help defeat a warlord, he is captured. Algren knows the fate of enemy prisoners, but he is surprised to be spared and then finds himself drawn to the samurai's way of life, amongst other things. (Action / Adventure / Drama / War) - 2003

itvmeridian.uk.title: Long Lost Family
itvmeridian.uk.description: When Anita was a child, her mother told her she had placed a baby boy for adoption when she was a teenager. Now that her mother has passed away, Anita wants to find her brother to tell him their mother always loved him. Ruth was a teenager when her sister had both her children taken from her by social services due to mental health issues. Now that her sister has passed, she wants to find the boys and tell them how much their mother loved them. (Documentary, Reality) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: Unwind with ITV

itvmeridian.uk.title: Deal or No Deal
itvmeridian.uk.description: Stephen Mulhern hosts as Sue gets her chance to open the iconic red boxes. She might be tempted to accept an offer from the Banker or be rewarded by standing firm and taking home what was inside her box all along. (Entertainment, Game show) - 2025

itvmeridian.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands - South Wales
itvmeridian.uk.description: James is in South Wales, accompanied by Michelin-starred chef Stephen Terry. James discovers award-winning Welsh wine and cooks a Welsh lamb ragu on a beautiful mountainside. He samples the delights of organic Welsh chocolate and visits cooking legend Shaun Hill at his renowned restaurant The Walnut Tree. The day comes to an end at Barry Island, where James and Stephen enjoy all the fairground rides at this famous resort and James cooks Barry Island churros overlooking the beach. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2020

itvmeridian.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh - Episode 25
itvmeridian.uk.description: Joining Alan to provide the chat this time are Selina Scott, Pixie Lott and Tom Parker-Bowles, and we also meet some rare-breed Guernsey goats with a royal title. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2024

itvmeridian.uk.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen - Fearne Cotton
itvmeridian.uk.description: Prue is joined by TV presenter turned entrepreneur Fearne Cotton who bakes her favourite carrot cake with blueberry icing mousse and tells Prue all about how painting and baking are her escapism from the stresses of everyday life. Prue has a taste for Italy as she makes Polpette in tomato sauce with creamy Parmesan. The food hero is the Mazi project, a charity in Bristol that nourishes marginalised 16 to 25-year-olds through food. (Cookery, Outdoors) - 2026

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Mastermind Australia
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Our weekly winners are back with two minutes of general knowledge, plus the dreaded slow burn round. Tonight's slow burn topics are: a historical event, a TV show, a song and a sportsperson. (Special Interest)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: 7 Up
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: The first of a series of documentary films that have followed the lives of fourteen British children since 1964, when they were seven years old. (Special Interest)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: 14 Up
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: A group of seven year-old boys and girls were asked about their attitudes to life, society and culture including their hopes for the future. (Special Interest)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: 21 Up
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: In another must-see programme from the 'Up' series, 21 Up profiles the lives of those seven-year-olds who opened there hearts and revealed all about the dreams and aspirations for the future 14 years. (Special Interest)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: 28 Up
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: In two uplifting productions, the 'Up' series returns 21 years later, and it's time to re-visit all those concerned - but how will have their lives and aspirations have changed. (Special Interest)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: 28 Up
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: In two uplifting productions, the 'Up' series returns 21 years later, and it's time to re-visit all those concerned - but how will have their lives and aspirations have changed. (Special Interest)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Brassic - The Great Bull Semen Heist
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Fresh out of prison, Vinnie tries to lie low under Detective Slater's watch, but when Farmer Jim offers a fast-cash job, he and his gang unleash chaos in a madcap scheme to steal frozen bull semen. (Comedy)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Brassic - Gideon's Mum Funeral
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: When Vinnie helps his friend Gideon honour his late mother's wishes, a heartfelt send-off turns into a mischievous nautical caper as they scramble to give her a burial at sea. (Comedy)

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: A Hazard Of Hearts
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: A beautiful young woman is sent to live at a forbidding cliff-top mansion after her father, a compulsive gambler, loses her and his estate in a wager. Based on the acclaimed novel by Barbara Cartland. (Drama)

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Girl You Know It's True
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: This energetic biographical drama charts the meteoric rise and spectacular downfall of pop sensation Milli Vanilli, revealing the fame, deception and scandal behind a global phenomenon. (Drama)

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Queen
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: After the death of Princess Diana, Queen Elizabeth II struggles with her reaction to a sequence of events nobody could have predicted. Starring Helen Mirren and James Cromwell. (Special Interest)

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: A King In New York
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: A recently-deposed European monarch from a fictional country seeks shelter in New York where he becomes an accidental TV celebrity. Before long he is accused of being a Communist. (Charlie Chaplin). (Comedy)

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: A United Kingdom
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: The story of King Seretse Khama of Botswana and how his loving but controversial marriage to white Englishwoman, Ruth Williams, in 1948 plunged his kingdom into political and diplomatic turmoil. (Drama)

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Storm Boy
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Based on the beloved book, Storm Boy tells of a young boy on Australia's remote coast who rescues three orphaned pelicans. (Drama)

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Gentlemen
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: From Guy Ritchie, The Gentlemen is a slick action comedy following American expat Mickey Pearson (Matthew McConaughey), whose London marijuana empire sparks schemes, bribery, and betrayal. (Action & Adventure)

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Private Desert
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Daniel has been suspended from active police work and is under internal investigation. When Sara, his internet love affair, goes missing, he decides to drive to her town in Bahia, in search of her. (Drama)
